response.text: Duplicate found (452/801). Now the fixed tie-out query.

arguments.sql: with g as (select "JRNL_NO", sum("CR_AMT") filter (where trim("ACCT_CD")='2000') ap_cr, sum("DR_AMT") filter (where trim("ACCT_CD")='2000') ap_dr, sum("DR_AMT") dr from "GLJRNL" group by 1) select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."JRNL_NO", h."SRC_REF", g.ap_cr, g.ap_dr, g.dr from "APINVH" i left join "GLJRNH" h on h."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" left join g on g."JRNL_NO"=i."JRNL_NO" where h."JRNL_NO" is null or coalesce(g.ap_cr,0)<>i."INV_AMT" or g.dr<>i."INV_AMT" order by 1

select l."JRNL_NO", l."LN_SEQ", l."ACCT_CD", l."DR_AMT", l."CR_AMT", h."PRD_ID" from "GLJRNL" l join "GLJRNH" h using("JRNL_NO") where trim(l."ACCT_CD") not in (select trim("ACCT_CD") from "GLCOA" where "ACTV_FLG"='Y') or l."DR_AMT"<0 or l."CR_AMT"<0 or (l."DR_AMT"<>0 and l."CR_AMT"<>0)

select p."PAY_ID", p."INV_ID", p."PAY_AMT", p."PAY_DT", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD", i."INV_DT", i."INV_NO" from "APPAYM" p left join "APINVH" i using("INV_ID") where i."INV_ID" is null or p."PAY_AMT"<>i."INV_AMT" or i."STAT_CD"<>'P' or p."PAY_DT"<i."INV_DT"

select i."INV_ID", i."INV_NO", i."INV_AMT", i."STAT_CD" from "APINVH" i where i."STAT_CD"='P' and not exists (select 1 from "APPAYM" p where p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID") or (i."STAT_CD"='O' and exists (select 1 from "APPAYM" p where p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID"))
